doc.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Twenty Downbeat poll wins and how the All-Stars were picked
summary: He won Best Clarinetist in the Downbeat poll many times; Metronome used critics and musicians.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: [laughter] So you were also, this I don’t have down, but you were also voted “Best Clarinetist” in the Downbeat polls.
And I wonder if, was that…
So the Downbeat polls, those were readers…
Readers. Murphy:…those were the fans voting.
The Metronome All-Stars, how did they choose?
Pretty much the same way except they gravitated toward more music critics and musicians voting for the first guys, number one guys.
